WITH per_item_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
        AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
        AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0
      THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost 
    END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.order_item_id) as line_item_count
  FROM Order_Items oi
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios,
  AVG(line_item_count) as avg_line_item_count
FROM per_item_stats;
